headline: South Africa Annual Inflation Edges Up to 4.5% in September
summary: South Africa's annual consumer price inflation edged up to 4.5% in September from 4.4% in August as fuel costs jumped, while core inflation eased to 4.0%.
why: Consumer price index readings guide the South African Reserve Bank in setting benchmark interest rates, affecting local borrowing costs, consumer discretionary stocks, and the South African rand.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Rising inflation driven by fuel costs influences upcoming central bank monetary policy decisions.
